tasks.title: Expose horizontalAlign in slide style editor
tasks.description: Add horizontalAlign to the slide style editor's styleKeys array in DeckBuilder so operators can set the horizontal component of the 3x3 placement grid. The presenter already reads slide.style.horizontalAlign; the builder must expose it alongside verticalAlign.

tasks.title: Add deck metadata editing UI
tasks.description: Add inputs to the DeckBuilder for editing deck-level fields: title, date, location, notes, and a useGreenScreen toggle checkbox. Currently these fields are read-only after load except via manual JSON edits.

tasks.title: Add operator message send UI
tasks.description: Add a dedicated text input and Send Message button in DeckBuilder that broadcasts a PresentData with only the message field set (no slide), satisfying design principle 5: supers go on program only when explicitly sent.

tasks.title: Add keyboard shortcuts for operator navigation
tasks.description: Implement keyboard event handling in DeckBuilder so the operator can navigate slides (ArrowRight/ArrowLeft or PageDown/PageUp) and step lyrics (ArrowDown/ArrowUp when in song mode) without using the mouse.

tasks.title: Add fullscreen API to presenter route
tasks.description: Add a button (or keyboard shortcut F) to the Presentation component that calls document.documentElement.requestFullscreen() so the presenter window can occupy the full capture surface for the video mixer feed.

tasks.title: Verify and pass lyrics navigation E2E tests
tasks.description: The Playwright spec in e2e/lyrics-navigation.spec.ts was written but has not been confirmed passing. Run the suite against a live dev server, fix any failures in the presenter or broadcast handling, and ensure all six lyrics-navigation scenarios pass cleanly.

tasks.title: E2E tests for 3x3 alignment grid
tasks.description: Write Playwright tests that send slides with each of the 9 horizontal+vertical alignment combinations and assert that the title overlay element has the expected CSS positioning in the presenter view, covering all cells of the upper/center/bottom x left/middle/right grid.

tasks.title: Standalone song JSON import in DeckBuilder
tasks.description: Extend the file upload handler to accept a standalone song JSON file matching the SongData shape (with title, author, verses, lines) without requiring a full Deck wrapper, auto-creating a single-slide song deck on load.

tasks.title: SQLite library schema and Remix loader scaffolding
tasks.description: Create the server-side SQLite schema (presentations, songs, assets tables) and stub Remix loader/action routes for the library, setting up the persistence layer so subsequent tasks can implement save, open, and list workflows.

tasks.title: SQLite library save and open deck
tasks.description: Implement the save deck action (persist current deck JSON and linked song records to SQLite) and the open deck loader (list saved presentations and hydrate the builder from a selected record), wiring them to the DeckBuilder UI.

tasks.title: SQLite library browser UI in DeckBuilder
tasks.description: Add a library panel to the DeckBuilder that lists saved presentations from SQLite (title, date, location) and lets the operator open, update, or delete them, completing the local working archive workflow from the epic.

No new tasks are needed beyond what's already planned. ```json [ { "id": 9, "title": "SQLite library schema and Remix loader scaffolding", "description": "Create the server-side SQLite schema (presentations, songs, assets tables) and stub Remix loader/action routes for the library, setting up the persistence layer so subsequent tasks can implement save, open, and list workflows.", "status": "backlog" }, { "id": 10, "title": "SQLite library save and open deck", "description": "Implement the save deck action (persist current deck JSON and linked song records to SQLite) and the open deck loader (list saved presentations and hydrate the builder from a selected record), wiring them to the DeckBuilder UI.", "status": "backlog" }, { "id": 11, "title": "SQLite library browser UI in DeckBuilder", "description": "Add a library panel to the DeckBuilder that lists saved presentations from SQLite (title, date, location) and lets the operator open, update, or delete them, completing the local working archive workflow from the epic.", "status": "backlog" } ] ``` --- ## Task 9: SQLite Library Schema and Remix Loader Scaffolding ### What and Why The epic's "Local library (SQLite)" section is the final major feature area remaining. Before save/open and the browser UI can be implemented (Tasks 10 and 11), the persistence layer must exist: a SQLite database file on disk, a schema with `presentations`, `songs`, and `assets` tables, and stub Remix loader/action routes wired to that database. This task creates that foundation so subsequent tasks have a stable API surface to build on. The project already runs on an Express + Remix server (`server/index.js`, `app/routes/`). The `app/routes/deck.tsx` route re-exports `DeckBuilder`; new library routes will live alongside it. No SQLite package is currently installed -- this task also adds the dependency. ### Dependency Selection Use `better-sqlite3` (synchronous, zero-config, runs in Node) as the SQLite driver. It fits naturally into Remix loaders/actions (which are synchronous-friendly on the server) and avoids WASM complexity. Add `@types/better-sqlite3` as a dev dependency. ### Implementation Guidance #### 1. Install the package ``` npm install better-sqlite3 npm install --save-dev @types/better-sqlite3 ``` #### 2. Create `app/utils/db.server.ts` This module is the single point of access to the SQLite file. It must: - Open (or create) a `poster.sqlite` file in the project root (or a configurable path via `process.env.POSTER_DB_PATH`). - Run `pragma journal_mode = WAL;` and `pragma foreign_keys = ON;` on open. - Export the `db` instance as a singleton (module-level `const`). - The file name must end in `.server.ts` so Remix excludes it from the browser bundle. #### 3. Create `app/utils/schema.server.ts` This module exports a single `initSchema(db: Database)` function that runs the `CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS` statements for the three tables: **`presentations`** - `id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY (a `genId()`-style UUID/nanoid) - `title` TEXT NOT NULL - `date` TEXT (ISO date string, nullable) - `location` TEXT (nullable) - `notes` TEXT (nullable) - `use_green_screen` INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 (0/1 boolean) - `deck_json` TEXT NOT NULL (full serialized `Deck` JSON blob) - `created_at` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')) - `updated_at` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')) **`songs`** - `id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY - `title` TEXT NOT NULL - `author` TEXT (nullable) - `song_json` TEXT NOT NULL (serialized `SongData` JSON blob) - `created_at` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')) - `updated_at` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')) **`assets`** - `id` TEXT PRIMARY KEY - `name` TEXT NOT NULL - `mime_type` TEXT NOT NULL - `data` BLOB NOT NULL (binary content) - `created_at` TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT (datetime('now')) Call `initSchema(db)` at the bottom of `app/utils/db.server.ts` immediately after opening the connection, so the schema is always initialized on first use. #### 4. Create `app/routes/library.tsx` This is the stub Remix route for the library. For this task it only needs to: - Export a `loader` that queries `SELECT id, title, date, location, created_at FROM presentations ORDER BY created_at DESC` and returns the rows as JSON (`json(rows)`). - Export a no-op default component that renders a `
Library (coming soon)
` so the route is accessible and does not throw. - Import `db` from `../utils/db.server`. #### 5. Create `app/routes/library.save.tsx` Stub action route for saving a deck. For this task: - Export an `action` that reads the request body (expect `application/json` with the full `Deck` JSON), inserts a new row in `presentations`, and returns `json({ ok: true, id })`. - No UI component needed; this is an API action route. - Import `db` from `../utils/db.server`. #### 6. Add `poster.sqlite` to `.gitignore` The database file must not be committed. Add `poster.sqlite` and `*.sqlite` (and `*.sqlite-wal`, `*.sqlite-shm`) to `.gitignore`. #### 7. TypeScript types In `app/utils/schema.server.ts`, export a `PresentationRow` interface matching the `presentations` schema fields (snake_case, matching DB column names). This will be used in Tasks 10 and 11. ### Testing Steps 1. **Schema smoke test** -- After running `npm run dev`, navigate to `http://localhost:3000/library`. The page must render without a server error (the stub component appears). 2. **Database file created** -- Confirm `poster.sqlite` was created on disk after the first request that imports `db.server.ts`. 3. **Table structure** -- Open the SQLite file with `sqlite3 poster.sqlite ".schema"` (or any SQLite browser) and verify all three tables exist with the correct columns. 4. **Save stub** -- Use `curl -X POST http://localhost:3000/library/save -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"id":"test","title":"Test","slides":[]}'` and confirm a `{"ok":true,"id":"..."}` response. 5. **Unit test** -- Add `app/utils/schema.server.test.ts` that opens an in-memory SQLite database (`:memory:`), calls `initSchema`, and asserts that querying `sqlite_master WHERE type='table'` returns `presentations`, `songs`, and `assets`. 6. **No regression** -- Run `npm test -- --watchAll=false`; all existing tests must pass. ### Acceptance Criteria - `better-sqlite3` is installed and listed in `package.json` dependencies. - `app/utils/db.server.ts` opens `poster.sqlite` (or `POSTER_DB_PATH`) as a singleton, enables WAL and foreign keys, and calls `initSchema` on open. - `app/utils/schema.server.ts` exports `initSchema` and `PresentationRow`; the three tables (`presentations`, `songs`, `assets`) are created with correct columns on first run. - `app/routes/library.tsx` exists with a working `loader` that returns the presentations list as JSON and a stub default component. - `app/routes/library.save.tsx` exists with an `action` that inserts into `presentations` and returns `{ ok: true, id }`. - `poster.sqlite`, `*.sqlite-wal`, and `*.sqlite-shm` are listed in `.gitignore`. - The schema test (`app/utils/schema.server.test.ts`) passes with an in-memory database. - All pre-existing tests pass (`npm test -- --watchAll=false`). - All new server-side modules end in `.server.ts` so they are excluded from browser bundles. - This task is traceable to the "Local library (SQLite)" section of `ralph/epic.md`. --- ## Remaining Planned Tasks - SQLite library schema and Remix loader scaffolding - SQLite library save and open deck - SQLite library browser UI in DeckBuilder 9 Now I'll create the files: Now let me check the Deck type to make sure we're importing correctly: Now update `.gitignore`: Now create the schema test.
